S0118.or: O God, the loving guardian of virginity, by whose grace Your handmaid Margaret united to the beauty of virginity the merit of good works; grant, we beseech You, that in the spirit of saving penance we may be able to restore integrity of mind
S0118.se: We beseech You, O Lord, look mercifully on these offerings and, by the intercession of blessed Margaret, whom You willed to be made a victim of penance for the salvation of her people, be appeased and grant to the human race peace in the charity of Christ
S0118.pc: Refreshed, O Lord, at the heavenly table, we humbly beseech You that, by the example of blessed Margaret despising the fashion of this world which passes away, we may deserve to arrive at eternal joys

S0123.or: O God, who chose blessed Raymond to be a renowned minister of the sacrament of penance, and wondrously brought him across the waves of the sea; grant that through his intercession we may bring forth worthy fruits of penance and be able to reach the haven of eternal salvation
S0123.se: Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts offered to Your majesty; and through the intercession of blessed Raymond, Your confessor, bestow on us the help of Your protection
S0123.pc: We beseech You, O Lord our God, that the feast of Saint Raymond, Your confessor, which we have celebrated, may obtain for us pardon of our sins and the glory of eternal happiness

S0125.or: O God, who taught the whole world by the preaching of blessed Paul the apostle; grant, we beseech You, that we who this day keep his conversion may come to You by following his example
S0125.se: Through the prayers of Your apostle Paul sanctify the gifts of Your people, O Lord; that what is pleasing to You by Your own institution may become yet more pleasing through the patronage of his pleading
S0125.pc: Hallowed by the saving mystery, O Lord, we beseech You that his prayers may never fail us, under whose patronage You have granted us to be governed

S0201.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who keep the feast of blessed Ignatius, Your martyr and bishop, may be helped by his intercession with You
S0201.se: May this victim, we beseech You, O Lord, cleanse away our sins, and hallow the bodies and souls of Your servants for the offering of this sacrifice
S0201.pc: Refreshed by partaking of this sacred gift, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that through the intercession of blessed Ignatius, Your martyr and bishop, we may feel the effect of the rite we celebrate

S0205.or: O God, who among the other wonders of Your power have bestowed even on the weaker sex the victory of martyrdom; mercifully grant that we who keep the heavenly birthday of blessed Agatha, Your virgin and martyr, may come to You by following her example
S0205.se: Receive, O Lord, the gifts which we offer on the feast of blessed Agatha, Your virgin and martyr, by whose patronage we trust to be delivered
S0205.pc: May the mysteries received, O Lord, be a help to us; and through the intercession of blessed Agatha, Your virgin and martyr, may they strengthen us with unfailing protection

S0210.or: O God, who, to show forth the way of innocence, caused the soul of Your blessed virgin Scholastica to enter heaven in the likeness of a dove; grant us by her merits and prayers so to live in innocence that we may deserve to attain to eternal joys
S0210.se: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation
S0210.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate

S0213.or: O Lord Jesus Christ, who willed that blessed Catherine, Your virgin, on fire with Your love, should shine forth by the contemplation of Your passion; grant through her intercession that we, devoutly recalling the mysteries of Your passion, may deserve to gather its fruit
S0213.se: Make us, we beseech You, O Lord, partakers of Your holocaust offered on the altar of the cross, by the contemplation of which most holy mystery You made blessed Catherine, Your virgin, wonderful
S0213.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty and merciful God, that these pledges of ineffable love which we have received may inflame us to love You in return; and that by the intercession and example of blessed Catherine, Your virgin, we may ever live in Your love

S0214.or: O God, who made blessed Jordan wonderful in zeal for the salvation of souls and by the grace of spreading the Order; by his merits and intercession grant that we may always live in the same spirit and find the glory laid up for us in heaven
S0214.se: May blessed Jordan, O Lord, present in the sight of Your majesty the gift of the heavenly banquet which we offer; and vouchsafe that, as it brings him glory, so through his intercession it may become for us the pledge of the true way and of everlasting life
S0214.pc: May the hope of eternal salvation which You have willed us to have through receiving Your Body and Blood, O Lord, remain secure; and may the prayer of blessed Jordan ever be a saving intercession for us to win glory

S0309.or: O God, who among the other gifts of Your grace honored blessed Frances, Your handmaid, with the familiar companionship of an angel; grant, we beseech You, that by the help of her intercession we may deserve to attain the fellowship of the angels
S0309.se: We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion, that through the holy pleading of blessed Frances they may become pleasing to You and salutary for us
S0309.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that through the glorious intercession of blessed Frances You would refresh with heavenly food those whom You have deigned to instruct by these saving mysteries

S0325.or: O God, who willed that Your Word, at the message of an angel, should take flesh in the womb of the blessed Virgin Mary; grant to Your suppliants that we who truly believe her to be the Mother of God may be helped by her intercession with You
S0325.se: Strengthen in our minds, we beseech You, O Lord, the mysteries of the true faith; that we who confess Him who was conceived of the Virgin to be true God and true man, may by the power of His saving resurrection deserve to attain eternal joy
S0325.pc: Pour forth, we beseech You, O Lord, Your grace into our hearts; that we, to whom the Incarnation of Christ Your Son was made known by the message of an angel, may by His passion and cross be brought to the glory of His resurrection

S0405.or: O God, who by the wonderful preaching of blessed Vincent, Your confessor, brought a multitude of nations to the knowledge of Your name; grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have as our rewarder in heaven Him whom he proclaimed on earth as the Judge to come, our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son
S0405.se: We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion; and that they may be pleasing to You and salutary for us, may blessed Vincent, Your confessor, who was glorious here by Your gifts, stand before Your mercy as our loving intercessor
S0405.pc: Filled with Your divine gifts, O Lord, we beseech You that through the glorious merits of blessed Vincent, Your confessor, we may feel the desired effect of the saving Victim

S0420.or: O God, who were pleased often to bedew blessed Agnes, Your virgin, with heavenly dew, and to adorn the places of her prayer with flowers of many kinds springing up; mercifully grant that through her prayers, sprinkled with the unfailing dew of Your blessing, we may deserve to receive the fruits of eternity
S0420.se: Be appeased, O Lord, by the gifts we offer; and as You were pleased to mark blessed Agnes, Your virgin, with the standard of the holy cross, so by her merits grant that we may be partakers of Your holocaust offered on the altar of the cross
S0420.pc: Hallowed by the offering of Your most holy Body and Blood, O Lord, grant that, the course of this life being joyfully finished, we may, through the intercession of blessed Agnes, a virgin most pleasing to You, deserve to enjoy eternal gladness

S0424.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who on earth venerate the crown of thorns of our Lord Jesus Christ in memory of His passion, may deserve to be crowned by Him with glory and honor in heaven
S0424.se: Strengthen the might of Your soldiers, O almighty King, that they whom the crown of Your only-begotten Son gladdens in the race of this mortal life may, when the course of the contest is finished, lay hold of the prize of immortality
S0424.pc: We humbly beseech You, almighty God, that these sacraments which we have received may, through the power of the most sacred crown of Your Son, whose feast we keep, avail us for healing

S0429.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may follow with fitting devotion the faith of blessed Peter, Your martyr, who for the spreading of that same faith merited to win the palm of martyrdom
S0429.se: Mercifully regard, O Lord, the prayers which we offer You through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your martyr; and keep under Your protection the champions of the faith
S0429.pc: Let the sacraments we have received safeguard Your faithful, O Lord; and through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your martyr, may they protect them against all hostile assaults

S0430.or: O God, who granted to blessed Catherine, adorned with the special privilege of virginity and patience, to overcome the assaults of evil spirits and to remain unshaken in the love of Your name; grant, we beseech You, that by imitating her we may trample on the wickedness of the world, overcome the snares of all our enemies, and pass safely to Your glory
S0430.se: Receive with kindly countenance, O Lord, we beseech You, the gifts we offer You in honor of blessed Catherine, Your virgin; and by her merits and intercession graciously bring us to Your joy
S0430.pc: Having received the sacraments of divine grace, O Lord, we beseech You that, through the intercession of blessed Catherine, a virgin most pleasing to You, we may overcome the assaults of the enemy, and, advancing toward the increase of eternal redemption, may ever be pleasing in Your sight

S0505.or: O God, who for the crushing of the enemies of Your Church and for the restoring of divine worship were pleased to choose blessed Pius as supreme Pontiff; grant that we may be defended by his protection and so cleave to Your service that, overcoming the snares of all our enemies, we may rejoice in everlasting peace
S0505.se: Receive, we beseech You, O Lord, the prayers and offerings of Your Church; that through the intercession of blessed Pius, Your confessor and pontiff, they may rise as an odor of sweetness in Your sight
S0505.pc: O Lord God, graciously pour forth the spirit of justice and fortitude upon Your faithful, whom You have deigned to protect from the assaults of all their enemies through the zeal and steadfastness of blessed Pius, Your confessor and pontiff

S0507.or: O God, for whose honor the glorious bishop Stanislaus fell beneath the swords of wicked men; grant, we beseech You, that all who implore his help may obtain the saving fruit of their petition
S0507.se: May our devotion be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, and may it become salutary for us through the pleading of blessed Stanislaus, Your martyr and bishop, on whose feast it is offered
S0507.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of blessed Stanislaus, Your martyr and bishop, whose feast we celebrate

S0509.or: O God, who gave to Your people blessed Gregory as a minister of eternal salvation; grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have as an intercessor in heaven him whom we had on earth as a teacher of life
S0509.se: Almighty and eternal God, through the intercession of blessed Gregory, Your confessor and bishop, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation
S0509.pc: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may everywhere be helped by the prayer of blessed Gregory, Your confessor and bishop, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty

S0518.or: O God, who have consecrated this day by the triumph of blessed Venantius, Your martyr; hear the prayers of Your people, and grant that we who venerate his merits may imitate the constancy of his faith
S0518.se: May the merits of blessed Venantius, Your martyr, make this offering acceptable to You, almighty God; that, helped by his aid, we may be made sharers of his glory
S0518.pc: We have received, O Lord, the sacraments of eternal life, and humbly beseech You that, blessed Venantius, Your martyr, pleading for us, they may obtain for us pardon and grace

S0519.or: O God, who raised blessed Peter Celestine to the height of the supreme pontificate, and taught him to set it aside for the sake of humility; mercifully grant that by his example we may despise all things of the world and happily deserve to attain the rewards promised to the humble
S0519.se: May Your saints, we beseech You, O Lord, everywhere make us glad; that while we recall their merits we may feel their patronage
S0519.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that giving thanks for the gifts we have received, we may, through the intercession of blessed Peter Celestine, Your confessor and pontiff, receive still greater benefits

S0526.or: O God, who raised blessed Philip, Your confessor, to the glory of Your saints; mercifully grant that we who rejoice in his feast may profit by the example of his virtues
S0526.se: Look graciously, O Lord, we beseech You, upon these present sacrifices, and grant that the Holy Spirit may enkindle us with that fire with which He wondrously pierced the heart of blessed Philip
S0526.pc: Fed with heavenly delights, O Lord, we beseech You that by the merits and imitation of blessed Philip, Your confessor, we may ever seek after those things by which we truly live

S0604.or: O God, who adorned blessed Francis, founder of a new Order, with zeal for prayer and love of penance; grant to Your servants so to advance in imitating him that, praying always and bringing the body into subjection, they may deserve to attain heavenly glory
S0604.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S0604.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Francis, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

S0614.or: O God, who gave to Your people blessed Basil as a minister of eternal salvation; grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have as an intercessor in heaven him whom we had on earth as a teacher of life
S0614.se: May the yearly feast of Saint Basil, Your confessor and bishop, make us acceptable to Your loving kindness, O Lord, we beseech You; that by these offices of holy propitiation a blessed reward may attend him, and the gifts of Your grace may be won for us
S0614.pc: O God, the rewarder of faithful souls, grant that through the prayers of blessed Basil, Your confessor and bishop, whose venerable feast we celebrate, we may obtain pardon

S0702.or: Almighty and merciful God, we humbly entreat Your majesty that, as You revealed Your only-begotten Son to the child enclosed in the womb through the visitation and greeting of His Mother, so by the merits and prayers of the same Mother You would grant us to contemplate Him for ever with unveiled face
S0702.se: Almighty and eternal God, who ever have care of all who trust in You; grant, we beseech You, that through the offering which we make to You we may always feel in our needs the spiritual visitation of the blessed Virgin Mary
S0702.pc: Almighty and eternal God, who willed that the commemoration of the Visitation of most blessed Mary, Mother of God, should be kept; grant, we beseech You, that through this sacrifice which we have received we may never fall away from the grace of her visitation

S0709.or: O God, who crowned with the laurel of eternity the glorious struggle for Your faith of Your blessed martyrs John and his companions; mercifully grant that, striving on earth by their merits and imitation, we may deserve to be crowned with them in heaven
S0709.se: Look down, O Lord, from Your sanctuary and from the lofty dwelling place of heaven upon the sacrifice which we offer; and, the blood of Your holy martyrs crying out, may our hearts glow with the fire of charity, and our prayers rise to You as an odor of sweetness
S0709.pc: O God, author and giver of strength, grant through the faith and constancy of Your holy martyrs that we who approach the sacred banquet may be kindled with the same ardor with which they offered their lives to You as a holocaust for the truth of Your Body and Blood

S0711.or: O God, who willed that the lands of Annam should be watered by the blood of the blessed bishops Ignatius and Dominic and their companions; through the intercession of these great martyrs make them flourish with the Christian religion
S0711.se: Almighty God, author and giver of fortitude, sanctify the gifts offered to Your majesty; and through the intercession of the blessed martyrs whose feast we celebrate today, heal the weaknesses of our hearts
S0711.pc: May Your sacraments, O Lord, we beseech You, give us that constancy with which they nourished the blessed martyrs unto victory

S0718.or: O God, who adorned blessed Camillus with a singular gift of charity for the help of souls struggling in their last agony; by his merits, we beseech You, pour into us the spirit of Your love, that in the hour of our death we may overcome the enemy and deserve to attain the heavenly crown
S0718.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S0718.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Camillus, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

S0722.or: Grant us, most merciful Father, that as blessed Mary Magdalen, by loving our Lord Jesus Christ above all things, obtained pardon of her sins, so she may obtain for us everlasting happiness from Your mercy
S0722.se: O God, awesome and most loving, may blessed Mary Magdalen enrich this victim of our offering with the increase of her prayers, and ask that it may avail for our healing
S0722.pc: May the sacred outpouring of the divine gift, O Lord, we beseech You, sanctify and protect us through the intercession of blessed Mary Magdalen, and make us co-heirs with the heavenly powers

S0726.or: O God, who raised blessed Anne, the mother of Your Mother, to the joys of heavenly life; grant, we beseech You, that by her glorious merits we may attain to eternal happiness, You who from her saving offspring deigned to take human nature for the salvation of the world
S0726.se: Accept, O Lord, the gifts devoutly offered, and grant that through the pleading merits of blessed Anne they may avail for the help of our salvation
S0726.pc: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may everywhere be helped by the prayer of blessed Anne, mother of the most blessed Virgin Mary, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty

S0802.or: O God, who through blessed Alphonsus Mary, Your confessor and bishop, on fire with zeal for souls, enriched Your Church with a new offspring; we beseech You that, taught by his saving counsels and strengthened by his example, we may happily come to You
S0802.se: O Lord Jesus Christ, burn our hearts with the heavenly fire of the sacrifice unto an odor of sweetness, You who granted blessed Alphonsus Mary both to celebrate these mysteries and through them to offer himself to You as a holy victim
S0802.pc: O God, who made blessed Alphonsus Mary, Your confessor and bishop, a faithful dispenser and herald of the divine mystery; grant by his merits and prayers that Your faithful may receive it often, and, receiving it, praise You without end

S0804.or: O God, who were pleased to enlighten Your Church by the merits and teaching of blessed Dominic, Your confessor, our Father; grant that through his intercession she may not be deprived of temporal help, and may ever grow in spiritual increase
S0804.se: Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts dedicated to You; that by the merits of blessed Dominic, Your confessor, our Father, they may avail us for healing
S0804.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who are weighed down by the burden of our sins may be raised up by the patronage of blessed Dominic, Your confessor, our Father

S0806.or: O God, who in the glorious Transfiguration of Your only-begotten Son confirmed the mysteries of the faith by the testimony of the fathers, and by the voice that came from the bright cloud wondrously foreshowed the perfect adoption of sons; mercifully grant that You may make us co-heirs of the King of glory Himself, and grant us to be sharers of that same glory
S0806.se: Sanctify, we beseech You, O Lord, the gifts offered, through the glorious Transfiguration of Your only-begotten Son, and cleanse us from the stains of sin by the splendor of His brightness
S0806.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may attain with the understanding of a purified mind the sacred mysteries of the Transfiguration of Your Son, which we celebrate with solemn office

S0817.or: O God, who made blessed Hyacinth, Your confessor, renowned among the peoples of many nations by the holiness of his works and the glory of his miracles; grant that we may be reformed for the better by his example and protected in adversity by his help
S0817.se: Through the intercession of Your most worthy Mother, may blessed Hyacinth, who walked fearless upon the waters, bring these sacred offerings before the sight of Your divine majesty, O Lord; and do You graciously deign to accept them, brought for our salvation
S0817.pc: We beseech You, O Lord, that those whom You have refreshed with the ineffable sweetness of Your Body and Blood, helped by the loving prayers of blessed Hyacinth, You would bring to eternal joy

S0821.or: Almighty and merciful God, who endowed blessed Jane Frances, on fire with Your love, with wonderful strength of spirit along every path of life in the way of perfection, and willed through her to enrich Your Church with a new offspring; grant by her merits and prayers that we who, conscious of our weakness, trust in Your strength, may by the help of heavenly grace overcome all that is against us
S0821.se: May this saving victim, we beseech You, O Lord, inflame us with that fire of love with which it vehemently kindled the heart of blessed Jane Frances and seared it with the flames of eternal charity
S0821.pc: Pour into us, O Lord, the spirit of Your charity, that, through the intercession of blessed Jane Frances, You would make those whom You have filled with the strength of the heavenly bread despise the things of earth and follow You alone, the true God, with a pure mind

S0827.or: O God, who through Saint Joseph, Your confessor, were pleased to provide a new help for Your Church in forming the young in the spirit of understanding and piety; grant, we beseech You, that by his example and intercession we may so act and teach as to obtain eternal rewards
S0827.se: We load Your altar, O Lord, with the gifts we offer; that they may become pleasing to You through the pleading of him by whose patronage You have granted us to be helped
S0827.pc: Hallowed by the saving mystery, O Lord, we beseech You that, through the intercession of Saint Joseph, Your confessor, we may ever advance to a greater increase of piety

S0829.or: May the venerable feast of Saint John the Baptist, Your precursor and martyr, O Lord, we beseech You, obtain for us the effect of saving help
S0829.se: We offer You gifts, O Lord, for the passion of Your holy martyr John the Baptist; and we beseech You that at his pleading they may avail us unto salvation
S0829.pc: May the blessed feast of Saint John the Baptist, O Lord, obtain for us that we may both venerate the great sacraments we have received in what they signify, and rejoice rather in what they bring about in us

S0830.or: Almighty God, bestower of all good things, who willed that blessed Rose, prevented by the dew of heavenly grace, should flower among the Indians in the beauty of virginity and patience; grant to us Your servants that, running in the odor of her sweetness, we may deserve to become the good odor of Christ
S0830.se: May the sacrifices of praise which we humbly offer You, O Lord, steeped in the fragrance of blessed Rose, Your virgin, be acceptable to You; that they may bring her honor, and become for us a propitiation unto salvation
S0830.pc: May our prayers rise to You, O Lord, fragrant with the sweetness of blessed Rose, Your virgin; that, refreshed in time with the food of heaven, we may enjoy the sweetness of the eternal banquet

S0908.or: Mercifully hear, O God, the supplication of Your servants, that we who are gathered together on the Nativity of the Virgin Mother of God may by her intercession be delivered by You from the dangers that threaten us
S0908.se: May the humanity of Your only-begotten Son, O Lord, come to our aid; that He who, born of the Virgin, did not lessen but hallowed His Mother's integrity, may on the feast of her Nativity free us from our sins and make our offering acceptable to You, Jesus Christ our Lord
S0908.pc: We have received, O Lord, the votive sacraments of this yearly feast; grant, we beseech You, that they may bring us remedies for this temporal life and for the life eternal

S0916.or: Mercifully regard our weakness, O Lord, we beseech You, and through the intercession of Your holy martyrs and bishops Cornelius and Cyprian turn away from us all the evils which we justly deserve
S0916.se: Look graciously, O Lord, upon the gifts of Your people, which are dedicated to Your majesty on the feast of Your holy martyrs and bishops Cornelius and Cyprian
S0916.pc: Filled with the saving mysteries, we beseech You, O Lord, that we may be helped by the prayers of those whose feast we celebrate

S0918.or: O God, who willed that blessed John, Your confessor, prevented by the abundance of Your grace, should flourish in a lowly state of life by the purity of his ways; grant us, we beseech You, so to follow in his footsteps that we may deserve to come to You with pure minds
S0918.se: We offer You, O Lord, sacrifices of praise in honor of blessed John, Your confessor, who for the salvation of the faithful continually offered himself to Your majesty as a victim of penance
S0918.pc: Grant, almighty God, that we who are refreshed with the bread of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed John, Your confessor, ever grow in Your love, You who gave him purity of life and perfect charity

S0919.or: O God, who gladden us by the yearly feast of Your holy martyrs Januarius and his companions; mercifully grant that we who rejoice in their merits may be kindled by their example
S0919.se: Be appeased, we beseech You, O Lord, by the gifts we offer; and through the intercession of Your holy martyrs Januarius and his companions defend us from all dangers
S0919.pc: May this communion, O Lord, cleanse us from guilt, and through the intercession of Your holy martyrs Januarius and his companions make us sharers in the heavenly remedy

S0921.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the venerable feast of blessed Matthew, Your apostle and evangelist, which we anticipate, may increase in us both devotion and salvation
S0921.se: Offering You the sacred mysteries in reverence of the apostolic dignity, we beseech You, O Lord, that through the prayers of blessed Matthew, Your apostle and evangelist, whose heavenly birthday we anticipate, Your people may ever both pour forth their prayers and obtain what they desire
S0921.pc: Appeased, O Lord, we beseech You, by the supplication of Your holy apostle and evangelist Matthew, grant us pardon and bestow on us everlasting remedies

S1005.or: O God, who willed that blessed Raymond, Your confessor, should be an eminent master of evangelical perfection and a faithful defender of apostolic authority; mercifully grant that we who live on earth after his example may deserve to be crowned with him in heaven
S1005.se: Through this offering and the intercession of blessed Raymond, Your confessor, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that despising earthly things we may ever set our thoughts on the things of heaven
S1005.pc: Having received the mysteries of Your Body and Blood, O Lord, we humbly entreat You that, through the intercession of Your servant Raymond, we may, after the dangers of this life, attain eternal joys in heaven

S1008.or: O Lord our God, who through Your only-begotten Son revealed heavenly secrets to blessed Bridget; grant to us Your servants, through her loving intercession, to rejoice with gladness in the revelation of Your everlasting glory
S1008.se: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation
S1008.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate

S1009.or: O God, who by mortification of the body and the preaching of the faith made blessed Louis, Your confessor, equal to the glory of the saints; grant that what we profess by faith we may ever fulfil by works of piety
S1009.se: We offer You, O God, the sacrifice of this sacred table, prepared for us by the King of kings, Jesus Christ; and through the pleading merits of blessed Louis grant us to draw from it our help and consolation
S1009.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty and merciful God, that we who celebrate the merits of blessed Louis may also imitate his virtues, and by imitating may advance, and by advancing may be able to come with him to the heavenly kingdom

S1014.or: O God, who see that we fail through our own weakness; mercifully restore us to Your love by the example of Your saints
S1014.se: May the mystical offering, O Lord, profit us, that it may both free us from our sins and confirm us in everlasting salvation
S1014.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that the sacred gifts may cleanse our guilt and bring about in us the effect of right living

S1015.or: Hear us, O God our Savior, that as we rejoice in the feast of blessed Teresa, Your virgin, so we may be nourished by the food of her heavenly teaching and taught by the affection of loving devotion
S1015.se: May our devotion, we beseech You, O Lord, be acceptable to Your majesty through the prayers of blessed Teresa, to whom the inmost holocaust of her heart was so pleasing
S1015.pc: We beseech You, O Lord our God, that Your household, subject to You, which You have fed with the bread of heaven, may through the intercession and example of blessed Teresa be able to sing Your mercies for ever

S1018.or: May Your holy evangelist Luke intercede for us, we beseech You, O Lord, who for the love of Your name ever bore in his body the mortification of the cross
S1018.se: Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord, through these heavenly gifts, to serve You with a free mind; that the gifts which we offer may, through the intercession of blessed Luke, Your evangelist, work in us both healing and glory
S1018.pc: Filled, O Lord, with heavenly blessing, we humbly entreat You that what we celebrate with our frail service we may feel to profit us through the help of blessed Luke, Your evangelist

S1101.or: Almighty and eternal God, who have granted us to venerate in one solemn feast the merits of all Your saints; we beseech You that, with our intercessors multiplied, You would bestow on us the longed-for abundance of Your mercy
S1101.se: We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion; may they be pleasing to You in honor of all the saints, and by Your mercy become salutary for us
S1101.pc: Grant to Your faithful people, we beseech You, O Lord, ever to rejoice in the veneration of all the saints, and to be defended by their unceasing supplication

S1105.or: O God, the exaltation of the humble, who caused blessed Martin, Your confessor, to pass to the heavenly kingdom; grant by his merits and intercession that we may so imitate his humility on earth as to deserve to be exalted with him in heaven
S1105.se: Graciously receive, O Lord, this victim which we offer to be consecrated to You in honor of blessed Martin, Your confessor; and grant that through his loving intercession it may bring us the effect of Your salvation
S1105.pc: Nourished with heavenly food, we humbly beseech You, O Lord our God, that, blessed Martin, Your confessor, interceding for us, we may ever be able to obey Your commandments

S1106.or: O God, who were pleased to make Your Church fruitful by the blood of the blessed martyrs Jerome, Valentine, Francis, Hyacinth and their companions; mercifully grant that we who joyfully recall their triumphs may be helped by their prayers and merits
S1106.se: Look graciously, O Lord, we beseech You, upon these present sacrifices; that through the intercession of Your blessed martyrs they may profit our devotion and our salvation
S1106.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that the feast of Your blessed martyrs Jerome, Valentine, Francis, Hyacinth and their companions, celebrated with heavenly mysteries, may obtain for us the pardon of Your mercy

S1119.or: Enlighten, O God of mercy, the hearts of Your faithful; and through the glorious prayers of blessed Elizabeth make us despise the prosperity of this world and ever rejoice in heavenly consolation
S1119.se: We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion, that through the loving pleading of blessed Elizabeth they may become pleasing to You and salutary for us
S1119.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that through the glorious intercession of blessed Elizabeth You would refresh with heavenly food those whom You have deigned to instruct by these saving mysteries
